attributes.name: Orchamus
attributes.powers:
When you examine this card, succeed at a Stealth 8 check or encounter it; the difficulty to defeat is increased by 3.

All damage dealt by Orchamus is Poison damage.

Before you act, you are dealt 1d4 Poison damage.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.
